visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a young woman with long, straight brown hair touching her chin with a manicured hand. She has multiple small piercings on her ear and is wearing a light-colored, silky robe. The background is a plain, neutral wall with warm lighting. (2) The scene shifts to the woman lying on a white bed, smiling and holding a black bottle with gold accents and a blue glass jar. (3) In a bathroom setting, she is seen in the mirror reflection applying a skincare product to her face; the room is brightly lit with modern fixtures. (4) A split-screen montage appears showing four different portraits of Korean female celebrities with flawless skin, used as a reference point. (5) The camera captures a detailed close-up of a black and gold pump bottle, labeled 'KORENA,' showing clear serum with gold-colored beads suspended inside. (6) She applies a few drops of the yellowish serum to her cheek and gently massages it in using upward motions with her fingers. (7) Close-up of her finger pressing against her cheek to demonstrate skin elasticity and a 'glass skin' glow. (8) She opens the blue 'KORENA' jar and uses a small gold spatula to scoop out a white, creamy product. (9) Several fast-cut sequences show her applying the cream to her forehead and chin, blending it with soft circular motions. (10) A side-by-side comparison or sequence of her face highlights the radiance and smoothness of her skin after application. (11) The woman lies back on the bed, holding both products near her face, smiling contentedly at the camera. (12) The final shot shows the product set displayed on a white surface, followed by a transition to the brand logo on a clean white background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar melody and light rhythmic percussion. A female voice speaks in a calm, welcoming Mandarin tone. (2) A soft 'whoosh' sound effect marks the first visual transition. The narrator explains the concept of home skincare. (3) A subtle 'shimmer' or 'sparkle' SFX plays as the celebrity montage is shown. (4) A 'pop' sound effect is heard as a droplet of serum is applied to the skin. (5) A clear 'ding' sound effect emphasizes the introduction of the product name 'KORENA'. (6) As the cream jar is opened, a soft mechanical click SFX is integrated into the mix. (7) Throughout the tutorial, the voice maintains a steady pace, synced with the rhythmic guitar strums. (8) A final rising stinger SFX plays as the logo appears, ending with a soft fade-out of the BGM.
